main_text.p: peccatis noftris meriti eramus, nobis pro ineffabili ipfiusMifericordiâ & bonitate propter Jefu Chrifti Sponforis & pacificatoris noftri fatisfactionem & meritum, quo ipfe à nobis perfolvens pro nobis fatisfecit Deo, condonatum fuit, atq; ejus loco datum vitæ æternæ præmium : modò credamus in Chri- ftum Jefum propitiatorem noftrum, refipifcamus, & abnegatâ omni impietate, vitæ innocentiæ & fanctimoniæ ftudendo, fidei veræ vitam & fructus Deo & homini comprobemus.

Quòd fi quâ ratione nobis innotuerit, quæratur, cùm neque Deum videamus unquam, nec audiamus loquentem, quisve nobis tanta divina gratia & liberalitatis non dubiam fidem fecerit ? Responsum est: ipsum Dei Filium dilectum, quem Pater de cœlo juffit audire, quiq; in sinu patris est, nobis id enarraffe, & multis modis confirmaffe, quin seipsum nobis salutem & vitam æternam, quam nobis suo merito acquisivit, daturum promisisse & probasse, ut sit Servator noster doctrinâ, Merito & Efficacia (li-

page.notes: The page ends mid-word at "(li-"; the catchword "cet" is printed at the lower right and is kept separate. Show-through from the reverse page is visible faintly at the bottom left and was not transcribed. A faint mark at the bottom left (possibly a signature) is unclear and was left out. Long s was normalised to plain s throughout. The printed "ipfiusMifericordiâ" lacks a space and is kept as printed.
